policy.grammar: the authenticated token must be one complete RFC 8259 number lexeme
policy.overflow: reject when the rounded result is positive or negative infinity
policy.underflow: accept subnormal results; reject a nonzero mathematical lexeme that rounds to signed zero
policy.negativeZero: preserve an exact negative-zero lexeme and emit -0; positive zero emits 0
policy.finiteOnly: reader and writer never return or emit NaN or Infinity
policy.format: shortest decimal that round-trips to the identical IEEE-754 value under roundTiesToEven
policy.exponent: lowercase e, no plus sign, and no redundant exponent leading zero

transactionality.reader: authenticate token and determine finite rounded result before returning a value; Reader state is readonly for token conversion
transactionality.writer: finite check and exact encoded-length check precede the first Writer output or structural mutation

requiredPortablePrimitives: correctly-rounded RFC8259 decimal lexeme to Float32 and Float64
shortest round-trip finite Float32 and Float64 formatting
rejectedImplementations: digit-by-digit floating accumulation without a proof of correct rounding

reference.provider: .NET invariant IEEE-754 parser and R formatter
reference.normalization: R output only supplies the shortest digit sequence; JSON exponent spelling is normalized separately

promotionGate: do not add production APIs until all three portable primitives exist on managed and self-host Windows/Linux/browser paths
